title: customer-success
text:
customer-success

Nora (CS): Cloudwell asks for an evening onboarding + Dedicated handoff session next Thu. Prefer 17:30 CET. Need facilitator, demo owner, runbook publisher, recording owner, 4 hands-on seats.
Diego (Solutions): I can run the demo and prep a minimal dataset for hands-on. 17:30 CET pushes into late APAC; suggest 17:00 CET to be kinder.
Kemi (EMEA CS): 17:00 CET is better for APAC. I can manage the recording start/stop and take notes for the renewal tracker.
Ben (CS Ops): I can reserve 4 lab seats and request a Dedicated pool. RSVP link and lab invite command after you confirm time.
Nora (CS): Let's move to 17:00 CET then. Keep it 75m: 15m intro, 30m demo, 25m lab, 5m feedback.
Diego (Solutions): Sounds good. I'll produce slides + a one-page pre-read. Can someone review Wed morning?
Kemi (EMEA CS): I'll review Wed morning and highlight any renewal risk language to surface to AM.
Ben (CS Ops): RSVP placeholder: https://cal.example.com/cloudwell-onboard. Lab reserve: `reserve-lab --customer cloudwell --seats 4 --expires 48h`. Requested Dedicated slots from eng-ops.
event-bot: Tip: enable cloud recording; add "Cloudwell: Redwood Onboarding" to event title.
Nora (CS): I'll build the feedback form (3 Qs + NPS) and post-event follow-up checklist. After the session Ben to publish recording + runbook within 48h.
Diego (Solutions): I'll upload slides Tue EOD. Tag me on review comments.
Ben (CS Ops): Event created: Cloudwell onboarding + Dedicated handoff 17:00 CET (75m). Recording enabled.
Nora (CS): Thanks everyone. Kemi will own notes/renewal-watch, Ben handles runbook + artifacts, Diego demo, I run invites & feedback. We'll flag account health if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
